title: Sentinel
description: Schema for the MEDIATE Sentinel entity. A Sentinel represents a monitored or managed component registered in the Service Manager registry. It includes operational status, threat status, heartbeat information, its related Overwatch, managed Assets, reconfiguration status, configuration version, and registration timestamp.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be sentinel.

operationalStatus.description: Property. Current operational status of the Sentinel.

threatStatus.description: Property. Current threat status of the Sentinel. Example: UNDER_THREAT.

lastHeartbeat.description: Property. Date and time of the latest heartbeat received from the Sentinel.

overwatch.description: Relationship. Overwatch entity associated with the Sentinel.

managedAssets.description: Relationship. List of Asset entities managed or monitored by the Sentinel.

lastReconfigurationStatus.description: Property. Last known reconfiguration execution status of the Sentinel. Example: SUCCESS.

configurationVersion.description: Property. Current configuration name or version associated with the Sentinel.

registrationTimestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the Sentinel was registered in the Service Manager registry.
